capabilities.name: Governed Non-Verdict Personalized Decision Support
capabilities.responsibility: Apply explicitly governed customer context, material-question planning, per-dimension alignment, interaction preservation, decision-sufficiency gating, and set-relative education-first projection without producing a product winner, ranking, suitability verdict, or recommendation.
capabilities.authority_role: Decision-support framing and sufficiency authority only. It may block, limit, or project governed comparison evidence relative to confirmed customer context, but it cannot aggregate dimensions into a net product direction, choose a product, rank alternatives, declare suitability, perform needs analysis, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Product-only turns prohibit customer-specific context even when an earlier turn was personalized.
Inferred customer facts or priorities cannot drive material alignment or deterministic circumstance relevance until confirmed.
Material questions require explicit traceable decision-relevant triggers and must not become a generic questionnaire.
Per-dimension findings and governed material interactions must remain visible and must not be collapsed into a net product direction.
Decision sufficiency must block or limit presentation when customer context, product evidence, hard constraints, interaction completeness, or comparison-set adequacy is insufficient.
Final decision-support projection is set-relative and must not contain winner, recommendation, suitability, or net-lean language; the user remains the decision maker.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the existing MO-027A through MO-027H decision-support runtime. The subsystem is deliberately education-first and non-verdict; recommendation authority remains outside this capability.
